doc.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Wess says many kids listen well while others ego-trip; Murphy thanks him and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, you do a great job leading by example.

Well, a lot of kids that are really listening, it’s just like I said, there’s a lot of good players and then there are some that are not. A lot of them are ego-tripping, so that happens and everything.
Well, Mr. Wess, thank you so much. It has been a pleasure and you’ve got the driest sense of humor of anybody I have ever talked to. It’s always fun.
Thank you. ### END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
